name: Deeproot Waters
oracle_text: Whenever you cast a Merfolk spell, create a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token with hexproof. (A creature with hexproof can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a Merfolk spell, create a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token with hexproof.

needs.what: a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token with hexproof
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has only merfolk_1_1_u, a vanilla 1/1 blue Merfolk with no keywords; create_token takes no keywords option, and a follow-up grant_keyword would be an effect on the token rather than a printed characteristic (copies of the token would lack hexproof). The trigger itself is expressible as spell_cast with controller you and filter subtypes [Merfolk]
